title: A story that changes a figure kb/_self docs quote carries those docs in its touches when it is planned
goal: Planning finds the kb/_self docs that quote a figure a story's goal changes (an anchored share, a wall time, a count) with selfdoc.py stale's map and a search for the figure, and puts them in the story's touches before the start; answers SP-ilje65fa, where ST-kbrsd24q changed the anchored share the design doc quotes, outside its touches, and the orchestrator added the doc at landing.
